goal: Form validation review: client and server checks, messages and accessibility of errors.
use: Form validation review: client and server checks, messages and accessibility of errors. Use when a form is added or changed.

steps.note: List the fields. Each input with its type and rules.
Check the server. Every rule must also run on the server.
Check the messages. Errors must say what to fix.
Check accessibility. Errors must be linked to their fields and announced.
Report. Each field with its gap and the fix.
